name: MithrilUI Debug
$comment: A diagnostic skin, not something to play with.
Every asset the sweep touches becomes a solid, garish colour keyed to the
rule that matched it. Select it in game and the answer to 'is that thing
my skin's fault?' becomes visual: if an element lights up, this skin
controls it and can be changed. If it looks exactly as it always did, the
client draws it and no skin can reach it.
red      catch-all: ornament that normally becomes transparent
Then pick 'MithrilUI Debug' in Options, look at the thing you are
